caseName: Gasoline Products Co. v. Champlin Refining Co.
caseNameFull: Gasoline Products Co., Inc. v. Champlin Refining Co.
attorneys: Mr. John B. Marsh for petitioner. Messrs. Horace G. McKeever, Harry 0. Glasser, and Carl C. Jones for respondent.

opinions.text: The petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court- of Appeals for the First Circuit is granted, limited to the question whether the Circuit Court of Appeals erred in limiting the new trial to the question of damages.
